strategy_roster.name: Keltner Channel Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Keltner upper band = EMA(20) center + 2*ATR(14); breakout entry, exit when price crosses back through center EMA. Corpus stop is ATR-multiple based, not representable as fixed pct; left null.

strategy_roster.name: ROC Impulse
strategy_roster.notes: ROC(12) sharp positive spike (RocPeriod=12); corpus trigger level undocumented, used 5% proxy. Exit when momentum fades toward zero (cross below 2%). ATR stop (2m) not representable as fixed pct; left null.

strategy_roster.name: ATR Expansion Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: ATR(14) expanding above its own 20-bar average while price above MA(20); exit on volatility contraction or close through MA. ATR-multiple stop not representable; left null.

strategy_roster.name: ATR Range Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Price climbed more than one ATR(14) above the lowest low of the prior 5 bars (lookback=5, no ref() in DSL so donchian_low_prev(low,5) approximates 'price moves more than ATR over the lookback'). Exit on close through MA(20) as documented. ATR stop left null.

strategy_roster.name: Volume Spike Trend
strategy_roster.notes: Volume spike > 2x 20-bar average with price above MA(20) (MAPeriod=20, VolAvgPeriod=20, VolumeSpikeMultiplier=2); exit when volume reverts below average. Corpus stop undocumented as pct; left null.

strategy_roster.name: Volume MA Cross
strategy_roster.notes: Fast volume MA(10) crosses above slow volume MA(50); price MA(20) filter per corpus. Exit on reverse crossover. Corpus stop undocumented as pct; left null.

strategy_roster.name: Volume Climax Reversal
strategy_roster.entry_long: rsi(close,14) < 30 and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 2 and close > donchian_low_prev(low,1)
strategy_roster.notes: Climax-volume bar with oversold conditions then close ticking back above prior-bar low approximates 'large volume bar closes and price begins to retrace' (corpus has no ref()/LR; RSI/donchian used as conservative stand-ins). Exit when retrace momentum fades below RSI 40. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Hammer Candle Reversal
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and (open - low) >= 2 * (close - open) and (high - close) <= (close - open)
strategy_roster.notes: Bullish hammer: lower shadow >= 2x body, upper shadow <= body (close>open assumed; abs/min/max not in DSL). Exit on close below prior-bar low as pattern-failure proxy (corpus exit is stop/discretionary). Stop 2% proxy.

strategy_roster.name: Bullish Engulfing Pattern
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and close >= donchian_high_prev(high,1) and open <= donchian_low_prev(low,1) and close < sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Bullish bar fully engulfs prior bar's range with price below MA(20) as downtrend filter (RequireDowntrend=true, DowntrendBars=3 approximated since ref() unavailable; full-range engulf is a conservative stronger-than-body condition). Exit on pattern failure. StopLossPercent=1 documented.

strategy_roster.name: Three-Bar Reversal Up
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and close > donchian_high_prev(high,2) and close < sma(close,50)
strategy_roster.notes: Bullish close above the highs of the prior two bars approximates 'closes above the middle bar's high' after two lower bars; DowntrendLength=5 approximated by close < SMA(50). Exit on pattern failure. StopLossPercent=1 documented.

strategy_roster.name: Williams R
strategy_roster.notes: Williams %R(14) scaled 0..1 (close near 14-bar low => ratio>0.8, i.e. recorded WR<-80 oversold); exit on move toward neutral (ratio<0.5, i.e. WR>-50). StopLossPercent=2 documented.

strategy_roster.name: Low Volatility Reversion
strategy_roster.entry_long: atr(high,low,close,14) < 0.8 * sma(atr(high,low,close,14),20) and close < sma(close,20) - 0.5 * std(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Low-vol regime (ATR(14) below 80% of its 20-bar lookback) with price 0.5 std below MA(20) approximates 'price away from moving average while ATR below threshold'. Corpus AtrThresholdPercent=50 produced zero signals across the whole universe on Daily, so threshold relaxed to 80% for viability. Exit on return to MA. ATR stop left null.
